props.gloss_en: R' Zeira found Rav Yehuda standing at the door of his father-in-law's house and saw he was in good spirits, [such that] had he asked him all the secrets of the world he would have told him
goats go first and then ewes: as at the creation of the world, where first there was darkness and then light
these, from which we cover ourselves, are covered
and these, from which we do not cover ourselves, are exposed
the camel's tail is short because it eats thorns
the ox's tail is long because it lives in marshes and must drive off gnats
the grasshopper's horn is soft because it lives among willows, and were it hard it would break off and [the grasshopper] be blinded
Shmuel: one who wants to blind a grasshopper should pull off its horns
the hen's eyelid rises upward because they live on rafters, and if smoke entered it would be blinded
chatzba (jug) -- for it hews water from the river
gelima (cloak) -- for in it one is made like a golem
purya (bed) -- for on it they are fruitful and multiply
the baraita: three, as long as they age, increase in strength -- the fish

supports.gloss_en: דאמר שמואל: one who wants to blind a grasshopper should pull off its horns -- so a horn that broke off would blind it
